function openInfo(code){selected=game(code);const unlocked=!!state.unlock[code];$('#mEm').textContent=selected.icon;$('#mName').textContent=unlocked?selected.name:'잠긴 게임';$('#mDesc').textContent=selected.desc;$('#mArea').textContent='장소 힌트 · '+selected.area.replace(/^해금 위치:\s*/,'');$('#mPlay').disabled=!unlocked;$('#mPlay').textContent=unlocked?'플레이':'GPS 획득 필요';$('#modal').classList.add('show')}
$('#mClose').onclick=()=>$('#modal').classList.remove('show');$('#mPlay').onclick=()=>{if(selected&&state.unlock[selected.code]){$('#modal').classList.remove('show');startGame(selected.code)}};
$$('nav button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{showPage(b.dataset.page);if(b.dataset.page==='mapPage')startGpsWatch()});
window.unlockFromNative=code=>{
 const c=parseUnlockQr(code)||normalizeUnlockCode(code);
 if(c)qrUnlock(c)
};

function fxText(x,y,text,color='#f39a11'){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fxText';e.textContent=text;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.color=color;s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),700)}
function particles(x,y,emoji='✨',count=6){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=emoji;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-35-Math.random()*85)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*300-150)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),760)}}

function showComboBurst(text,count=2,kind='combo'){
 const s=$('#stage');if(!s)return;
 $$('.comboBurstFX').forEach(e=>e.remove());
 const tier=count>=10?3:count>=5?2:1,e=document.createElement('div');
 e.className=`comboBurstFX tier${tier} ${kind||''}`;e.textContent=text;s.appendChild(e);
 const r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height*.19;
 particles(x,y,count>=10?'🔥':count>=5?'⭐':'✨',count>=10?18:count>=5?13:9);
 const p=520+Math.min(12,count)*28;beep(p,.055,.020,'square',p*1.20);setTimeout(()=>beep(p*1.25,.065,.016,'triangle',p*1.33),58);
